p.title: v59.97 a failing theme-detail playbook render no longer silently skips the teach render
p.symptom: On opening a theme detail, one try block ran the playbook render and then the teach render with an empty catch; a throw in the first skipped the second with no trace.
p.root_cause: Two independent renders shared one try with a silent catch.
p.fix: Each render has its own try, and each failure is logged through root._aioLog('warn', 'themes', ...).
p.violated_rule: A failure is visible in the log; one surface failing does not take an independent one down silently.
p.prevention: No test: the themes page has no mount test that can make the imported playbook renderer throw.
p.verification: node --check src/ui/pages/themes.js; node scripts/ci-esm-core-unit-check.mjs and node scripts/ci-desktop-continuity-check.mjs exit 0. Not checked in a browser.

changelog: **Theme detail guards ({P}):** the theme detail's playbook and reading blocks render under separate guards and log a failure, so one failing no longer hides the other silently.
note: v59.97: theme detail renders guarded separately
